findings.evidence: Crawled 3 pages; none contain JSON-LD, microdata or RDFa.
findings.mechanism: Structured data is the only channel that states a fact in a form requiring no inference. Without it every attribute — price, hours, author, rating — must be guessed from prose, and guesses are frequently dropped rather than risked.

suggested_action.expected_impact: Key attributes become directly readable rather than inferred.
steps: Add an Organization (or LocalBusiness) node on the home page with name, url, logo, description and sameAs.
Add the type matching each template: Product on product pages, Article on posts, FAQPage where questions are answered.
Emit as JSON-LD in a script tag rather than inline microdata.
suggested_action.summary: Add JSON-LD to every template, starting with Organization on the home page.

findings.title: No structured data anywhere on the site
